Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

r4agent (development version)

  • agent_agreement() reports inter-run reliability from a run with repeats: overall percent agreement (mean pairwise), Cohen’s kappa for two runs or Fleiss’ kappa for three or more, and a per-case breakdown ordered with the least-agreeing cases first. Where consistency() gives a raw disagreement rate and score_confidence() bounds a single run’s score, this is the chance-corrected agreement across repeated runs. Textbook formulas (Cohen 1960, Fleiss 1971) with the Landis & Koch (1977) strength label cited in the help; it calls no model and changes no score or verdict.
  • score_confidence() puts a Wilson confidence interval on each per-slice score, so a slice of three passing cases (point score 1.0) is no longer read the same as a slice of three hundred. Supply thresholds and it reports both whether the point score clears the bar and whether even the lower bound does; a slice that clears on the point estimate but not the lower bound has too few cases to claim. The interval is a closed form, deterministic and offline, and the function changes no score and no verdict: readiness() is unchanged.
  • diff_runs() now lists regressions most-severe first. It had ordered them by the severity string, which sorts alphabetically and pushed a failed critical case to the bottom of the list instead of the top.
  • suite_audit() lints an r4agent_suite for coverage and quality gaps: families or severities with no cases, slices below a minimum case count, cases with no stated why, and the absence of abstention or injection coverage. The findings are advisory, carry no severity and change no score or verdict; the audit never runs the suite or calls a model.
  • write_agent_suite() serialises an r4agent_suite back to the YAML that read_agent_suite() reads, so a suite built in R round-trips through a file. A case whose grader is a function cannot be serialised: it is kept with every other field and a warning names it, and its grader falls to the default on re-read.
  • consistency_strata() reports run-to-run instability broken down by slice and by severity, so an unstable slice, or instability concentrated in the critical cases, is visible rather than averaged into one flat rate. The existing consistency() output is unchanged.
  • agent_suite() now accepts bare cases (agent_suite(case1, case2)) as well as a list of cases, as its documentation already stated; previously a bare case was spliced into its fields and rejected.
  • Added a “Getting started” vignette walking through a benchmark end to end with a deterministic, offline stand-in agent (no network or model calls).
  • Expanded the test suite with edge cases for case and threshold validation, warn-as-half scoring, the readiness verdicts, custom and malformed graders, and the evidence, diff, consistency and report paths.

r4agent 0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • agent_suite(), agent_case(), agent_thresholds() and read_agent_suite() define a benchmark suite: cases with an expected answer, a slice and a severity, plus the slice thresholds agreed before a run.
  • run_benchmark() runs an agent or language model against the suite and score_slices() grades the results locally and deterministically, with no model called to judge another model.
  • readiness() returns a production readiness answer, consistency() checks run-to-run stability, and diff_runs() surfaces a case that used to pass and now fails instead of averaging it away.
  • agent_evidence() emits the results as R4SUB evidence rows via ‘r4subcore’, and report_markdown() writes a shareable report.
  • register_grader() and graders_available() expose the pluggable, offline grader interface.
